question: Should published changelogs support audited replacement, append-only corrections, or remain immutable across both skills and packages?
rationale: Current main stores one changelog value and defines no correction provenance, so the permanent authorization and historical-record semantics require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Audited revisions
options.body: Allow authorized replacement while retaining the previous text, actor, timestamp, and correction reason.

options.title: Append-only corrections
options.body: Keep the original changelog immutable and attach a separately visible correction record.

options.title: Immutable changelogs
options.body: Require a new version to communicate changed release notes and add no edit operation.

recommendation.title: Audited revisions
recommendation.body: Allow authorized replacement while retaining the previous text, actor, timestamp, and correction reason.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent ownership signal for current version lifecycle and release-record behavior.
